description: Search what users report about AI agents and developer tools: known bugs, errors, fixes (with the version) and official workarounds, plus questions answered from official docs. Give an error message or a symptom (e.g. '401 Unauthorized codex', 'claude -p uses more of the limit', 'windows terminal flashing'). Each result links the GitHub issue and AgentGid's page; statuses update daily.

item.description: Optional: product slug or name, e.g. claude-code, openai-codex, cline

query.description: The error message or symptom, in plain words

name: find_known_issues
title: Known issues, fixes and workarounds
